An anchor-wrapped table inside a layout cell keeps its inner links clickable

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td><a href="/outer"><table><tr><td><a href="/one">One</a><a href="/two">Two</a></td></tr></table></a></td></tr><tr><td>After</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(br_in_tables: true, compact_tables: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
